'''Cugle''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The pilot was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]] in the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and flew a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]].
